title: Chained Soldier
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a near-future Japan, portals open to a dimension called Mato, where peaches grant powers only to women, flipping society toward matriarchy. Student Yuuki Wakura wanders in and is saved by commander Kyouka Uzen, who binds him as her 'combat slave'; each victory requires a reward involving kissing and intimate contact.
life_message: It holds up power, service and reward as the path to strength and belonging.
